@@U00431@@
But enough of this mooning, this dabbling in grief and misery that gets you nowhere but gnaws at you like a vulture! Why, even in the worst of company you'd feel alive and a part of life. And, no, I’m not about to thrust you into the hoi polloi. I may not be on the highest echelon of devils, but I’m not the shabbiest, either; and if you'd be content we join forces for life, I'd oblige you anything on the spot. We'll be brothers-in-adventure, and, if I suit you, I'll even be your servant—your slave.

@@U00433@@
And what's your reward for all of this?

@@U00435@@
Oh, I wouldn't worry; your credit’s in good order.

@@U00437@@
No, not a bit of it, no! The Devil’s an egoist. He doesn’t work for free to benefit man. He’s out for himself is what he is. Lay it out. Your terms. Servants like you don’t come without trouble.

@@U00439@@
I pledge myself to you in shis life, no matter what. Over there, when we meet in the next, you'll do the same for me.

@@U00441@@
Over there? Over there means nothing to me.
translation:
@@U00431@@
但这种沉思、这种沉浸在悲伤和痛苦中的经历已经够多了，这种悲伤和痛苦只会让你一事无成，只会像秃鹰一样啃咬你！为什么，即使在最糟糕的陪伴下，你也会感觉自己还活着，是生活的一部分。而且，不，我不会把你推入大众之中。我或许不是恶魔中最高级的，但也不是最寒酸的；如果你愿意我们携手共度一生，我会当场满足你的一切要求。我们将成为冒险兄弟，而且，如果我适合你，我什至可以成为你的仆人——你的奴隶。

@@U00433@@
而你对这一切的回报是什么？

@@U00435@@
哦，我不会担心；你的信用状况良好。

@@U00437@@
不，一点也不，不！魔鬼是一个利己主义者。他不免费工作来造福人类。他就是为了自己。把它摆出来。你的条件。像你这样的仆人不会没有麻烦。

@@U00439@@
我向你保证，无论如何，我一生都会向你保证。在那里，当我们下次见面时，你也会为我做同样的事情。

@@U00441@@
在那儿？那里对我来说毫无意义。
